email_record.subject: The other option
email_record.body: Can you change it to the other option we discussed? I cannot find the earlier conversation. Please let me know.

email_record.subject: Regarding our earlier discussion
email_record.body: Please use the version we settled on during the call. I do not have the earlier details with me. Can you take care of it?

email_record.subject: Pages missing from printed menus
email_record.body: Two pages are missing from several of the menus we collected yesterday. Could the owner review this and let us know the next step?

email_record.subject: Quote for business cards
email_record.body: We would like 500 double-sided full-color business cards. We have not finalized the print file. What is the base price and what artwork information do you need?
